description: Two cost sensors. context-guard (UserPromptSubmit): estimates context-window fill, detects edit/error loops, and — in a narrow band, throttled — runs a cheap Haiku check for topic drift, suggesting /compact or a fresh session. session-weight (SessionStart): measures the static baseline every session pays for (CLAUDE.md chain, @-imports, skill/agent descriptions) and names the heaviest file. Both emit a systemMessage and never block.
